text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Our student council activities involve a
lot of
photography today...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Quite frankly, I'm fed up with it... But as
the
Empress, this is my duty.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I must embody everyone's ideals in
physical form.
If that means enduring
photoshoots, so be it.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Although, I could do without the flash...
My
eyes...
